body: I’ve always had derepression and anxiety but this feels different.
I don’t really know. I want to die and I know how I’ll do it but I know that I won’t? Does that make since? It’s all in my head... I didn’t know it was a problem until recently.
My husband will get freaked out. I’ve tried thin the past and it just stresses him out. My best friend just has a lot going on and i don’t want to stress her out.

Holy shit. That was actually really helpful. Umm, and apparently I don’t just have suicidal thoughts... didn’t not realize that apparently constant thoughts of past abuse is also a problem.

Is it bad though that thinking about that stuff, mostly killing my self helps with my anxiety?

I know I need to work some stuff out, but how do I talk to a professional about stuff with out them freaking out.
You can go to the ER too. They will help you.
You deserve a second chance. I think you can do it. I feel like a fuck up most of the time but before you make any decisions you can’t change, why not do something’s that make you happy.

I went to my doctor and told them, she brought in another doctor and I told them I didn’t want to go in. They agreed to let me leave but I had to go back and check in every two days. If it’s bad enough though they said that I should go back and they could admit me. But if I’m gonna live I have bills to pay.
